# Three-seed block-2 versus block-4 campaign

16 selection / 32 confirmation episodes × 1,024 steps; agent seeds 42, 43, 44.
Every cell is **B2 ; B4**. Ladder/Full-State cells are occupancy / mirror actions changed; other main-table cells are reward/step.
Mean ± sample SD across agent seeds, not standard error. Ladder joint encoder entries repeat its single representation.
